info.name: Ferryman Tobin
pages: So the light is burning again. I am Ferryman Tobin.
I tie up here in the cove because the beacon shines straight down on this water. No better mark to steer by.
Lastlight is burning, so the skiff is ready whenever you are.
Board her at the end of the pier and I will row you across to Hearthmere.

results.name: boarding the skiff at the end of the pier sails for the mainland

said: The drift ladder is roped off. Foreman Durgin wants to see a bronze dagger first.
Warden's welcome pack: 25 crowns, bread, runes, arrows, a shield, leather body and teleport tabs. Your tools and forged dagger come with you.
Tobin pushes off from the pier.
The skiff noses into Hearthmere. Hollow Well Square lies just ahead.
